purpose: private authored activity pilot; not learner-facing

activities.cueEnglish: Find where the warning tape goes.
activities.modelFrench: Installez le ruban de signalisation autour de la zone d’exclusion.
activities.modelEnglish: Put up the warning tape around the exclusion area.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the exclusion area in French.
Listen and identify the word for debris chute.
Type 'Do not stand under the work.' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Ne restez pas sous la zone de travail.

activities.cueEnglish: Warn the ground crew that debris is coming down.
activities.modelFrench: Attention en bas ! Des débris vont tomber !

activities.cueEnglish: Write when the ground crew may return.
activities.modelFrench: Attendez que je confirme que la zone est dégagée.
activities.modelEnglish: Wait until I say it's clear.

activities.cueEnglish: Find what the workers replace in the damaged section.
activities.modelFrench: Les ouvriers remplacent le contreplaqué endommagé.
activities.modelEnglish: The workers replace the damaged plywood.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the repair photo in French.
Listen and identify the French word for sheathing.
Type 'Show me the damaged area.' in French.
Ask how large the repaired section is.
activities.modelFrench: Le contremaître demande : « Quelle est la taille de la partie réparée ? »
activities.modelEnglish: The foreman asks: How big is the repaired section?

activities.cueEnglish: Write what is photographed before it is covered.
activities.modelFrench: Prenez une photo de la zone réparée avant de la recouvrir.
activities.modelEnglish: Take a photo of the repaired area before covering it.

activities.cueEnglish: Find what the foreman checks around the vent.
activities.modelFrench: Vérifiez le solin autour de cet évent.
activities.modelEnglish: Check the flashing around this vent.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the pipe boot in French.
Listen and identify the French word for penetration.
Type 'Is the pipe boot cracked?' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Le manchon du tuyau est-il fissuré ?

activities.cueEnglish: Ask the crew lead what has already been checked.
activities.modelFrench: Il demande au chef d’équipe : « Qu’avez-vous déjà vérifié ? »
activities.modelEnglish: He asks the crew lead: What have you already checked?

activities.cueEnglish: Write what is photographed at each penetration.
activities.modelFrench: Prenez une photo du solin autour de chaque traversée.
activities.modelEnglish: Take a photo of the flashing around each penetration.
